How To Play Mahjong Solitaire:

The goal of the puzzle game Mah jongg is to remove all the tiles from the games by matching pairs of identical tiles. When you match a pair, it will disappear and reveal what was under it. You can only remove majong tiles that are free and not covered or between other tiles. Match them all and you solve the puzzle.

In the free puzzle game Mahjong Solitaire Epic, all Majong puzzle games are possible to win. There is always at least 1 solution, but certain Mahjongg puzzle games are tougher than others. Use logic skills to solve the mah jongg games.
